text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. When did your fever and abdominal tenderness start, and how many days postpartum are you currently?

text: You mention urinary frequency and uterine tenderness; do you have any pain or burning sensation when you urinate? I would also like to know if you have had any chills or if the lochia (vaginal discharge) has a foul odor.

text: I need to clarify if you are experiencing any burning or pain during urination to rule out a urinary tract infection. Additionally, has your vaginal discharge (lochia) developed a foul odor, which would suggest an infection of the uterus?

text: Past medical history: Uncomplicated pregnancy leading up to a vaginal delivery. No significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: Does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use illicit drugs. Lives with her partner.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Given the uterine tenderness and fever, I need to check if your vaginal discharge has a foul odor, which would point to endometritis. I also want to know if you have had any chills or if the pain is localized to one side of your abdomen.
